aka: Verborgen im Eis – Geheimnisse aus der Vergangenheit
description: In this brand-new season, Secrets in the Ice will delve into the profound mysteries revealed by our planet's melting ice. As climate change accelerates, these icy remnants offer astonishing glimpses into Earth’s past and potential future. Each episode combines thrilling historical mysteries, groundbreaking scientific discoveries, and captivating tales from the frozen corners of the world. Through its compelling storytelling, cutting-edge science and beautiful CGI visualisations this season continues to illuminate the profound connection between our planet’s past and its future, inviting viewers to reflect on the fragile nature of our world and the ongoing quest for understanding. This season will explore mysteries across the globe in locations such as Scotland, Iceland, Sweden, Norway, China and more.
